payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates over all bus stop indices from i=2 to n-1, computing bus time plus Euclidean distance running time, tracking the minimum time and choosing the stop with smallest squared horizontal distance on ties.
payload.rationale: The code linearly scans all candidate stops to find the optimal one. No recursion, pruning, or state transitions are present. While none of the given complete_search subtypes exactly match a simple linear scan, search_backtracking is the most generic exhaustive search pattern.
